title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before the Arima Kinen, Vodka decides to make time to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka makes a bet with Daiwa Scarlet before the race. Daiwa Scarlet suggests that the winner be crowned the queen, and the loser has to do whatever the queen says.
